review_basis: Fresh clean-rebuild four-frame contact-sheet review bound to current footage and contact-sheet SHA-256 values. No prior-project approval was reused.

rejected_assets.reason: The blue synthetic hacking interface looked like a low-cost science-fiction overlay and did not provide a credible physical analogue for agentic cyber operations.
The stadium corridor crowd did not represent ordinary shared urban life and would misstate the narration's distributed social consequences.
The green hacker-screen imagery was a visual cliché and could be mistaken for proof of an attack rather than defensive cyber operations context.
The previous shot prominently combined Swiss and EU flags and was misleading in a section specifically about EU AI Act designation rules.
The previous computer screen visibly showed a sales-customer interface and was unrelated to independent technical evaluation or audit.
The classroom-style technology-business presentation lacked the authority and visual quality required for incident reporting and formal oversight.

approved_uses.narration_anchor: Every major AI lab on Earth believes moving this fast might be dangerous.
approved_uses.semantic_rationale: Developers jointly examining software gives the opening a credible human frontier-technology context without suggesting that the stock footage depicts a named AI laboratory.

approved_assets.decision_rationale: Across all four frames, the clip consistently shows developers examining software together; it supplies credible human AI-development context without implying a named laboratory.

approved_uses.narration_anchor: And every one of them is still moving as fast as it can.
approved_uses.semantic_rationale: A moving view through active server infrastructure makes the physical acceleration and scale of the AI race visible.

approved_assets.decision_rationale: All sampled frames maintain a moving view through active server infrastructure, clearly carrying the physical scale and acceleration of the AI race.

approved_uses.narration_anchor: In controlled evaluations, researchers have deliberately pushed frontier models toward their limits.
approved_uses.semantic_rationale: Two developers deliberately reviewing software on a shared screen represents a controlled evaluation process while the official research remains the factual evidence.

approved_assets.decision_rationale: The four frames consistently show two developers conducting a deliberate shared-screen review, avoiding the rejected hacker cliché and supporting controlled-evaluation context.

approved_uses.narration_anchor: None of this happened in the wild. These were designed tests, built specifically to see how far a model would go.
approved_uses.semantic_rationale: People reviewing software in a controlled office makes the test-versus-deployment distinction concrete without reenactment.

approved_assets.decision_rationale: The sampled sequence remains a controlled office software review, clearly reinforcing the distinction between designed tests and real-world deployment without reenactment.

approved_uses.narration_anchor: Stanford's 2025 AI Index reported nearly thirty-four billion dollars in private generative-AI investment in 2024.
approved_uses.semantic_rationale: A professional market-data environment supports the narration about capital flow while the factual number remains carried by primary evidence.

approved_assets.decision_rationale: All frames preserve a professional market-data environment, supporting the investment-scale narration while leaving the factual figure to primary evidence.
